descriptions.zh-Hans: 里约黑豆炖肉的自画菜单，包带画在椅边。
descriptions.en: A hand-drawn Rio feijoada menu with the bag strap beside the chair.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使在里约用短线记脆响的小菜单。
descriptions.en: The messenger’s Rio biscuit menu with strokes for a crackle.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在里约缆车行程前自写的便纸，曾拿反过。
descriptions.en: A homemade slip for Rio’s cable-car stops, once held upside down.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使吃过里约木薯脆饼后画的响声纸。
descriptions.en: A paper sound sketch after a tapioca biscuit in Rio.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在里约植物园写下的两行名字，纸笔都是信使带来的。
descriptions.en: Two plant names noted at Rio Botanical Garden, on the messenger’s own paper.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使把里约缆车行程接成线后亲手折的个人小卡。
descriptions.en: A hand-folded personal card joining the messenger’s Rio cable-car stops.
